name: @nuri/spec
description: Nuri spec · PURE DATA · the source of truth, nothing else (projection model · decision 80 · docs/projection-model.md §2). NO-DEPS / NO-SCRIPTS / NO generated artifacts. Tree: tokens/ (the dimension·colour·typography token SoTs) · axes/ (the resolve-map·palette-surface·interactive-effects·typography-axis·property-spelling·interaction definition tables) · components/ (the descriptors + schema · source only) · icons/ (the SVG SoT). Every consumer is a PROJECTION that generates + owns its resolved output: @nuri/rn (the RN contract · generated/) + @nuri/prototype (the web CSS + twins · generated/). The codegen lives in root scripts/ (N+53).
//: exports map lists ONLY DATA subpaths — no generated artifacts (those left spec for the two projections at N+62 · the infra exit · decision 80 §8 slice 3). The generated subpaths ./tokens ./token-paths ./token-vars ./interaction ./icons ./palette were DROPPED: the resolved RN contract now lives in @nuri/rn/generated/ (contract.ts imports it locally) + the web token-vars in @nuri/prototype/generated/. The descriptor subpaths (schema + button · icon-avatar · topbar · icon-button · tab-bar-item · tab-bar) keep their ./descriptors/<name> NAMES (rn imports @nuri/spec/descriptors/<name>) but map to the authored source at components/; the subpath === the component's PUBLIC name (deterministic-naming · SEED-2). The axis/SoT subpaths (resolve-map · property-spelling · palette-surface · interactive-effects · typography-axis · dimensions · colours) map to axes/ + tokens/; they are PURE DATA (only `import type`, no node/codegen deps · safe for the RN bundle + the prototype/doc cross-package TS data loader). @nuri/rn (factory resolve.ts · contract.ts) reads resolve-map/property-spelling/interactive-effects/descriptors; @nuri/prototype (css-preview.js) reads resolve-map/property-spelling/palette-surface/interactive-effects/typography-axis; @nuri/doc (strip.js loader) reads resolve-map/property-spelling/palette-surface/interactive-effects/typography-axis/dimensions/colours. The build/ + pipeline/ + lib/ + styles/ dirs are GONE; @nuri/spec is data-only.
